objective: QA round 2 of 3 for Milestone 2: confirm the four findings from reports/18-qa-m2.json are fixed by reports/19-game-dev-m2-fix.json, confirm the accepted hero edit (meshopt decoder off in components/avatar/Avatar.tsx) changes no hero behaviour, and re-check that nothing approved in round 1 regressed.

projectContext.query: 3D playable game avatar locomotion animation canvas hero transition talking avatar gestures projects skills contact

acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint, npm test and npm run build were each run by QA on Node 22 with exit codes explicitly captured (build in a copy of the tree, online and with network blocked), with output tails recorded (353 tests or more; / route First Load JS within 2 kB of 125 kB), and the bundle and request proof from round 1 still holds.

F-M2-1 is confirmed fixed with QA's own focus probe: after a slow-load Play (strip shown), a touch-emulation Play and a Retry-then-enter Play, Exit leaves Play as the only focus target and the final active element; the new shell regression test fails when the fix line is reverted in a temp copy.

F-M2-2 is confirmed fixed: per-frame fov and silhouette traces of Exit at scroll 0 and a scrolled offset arrive with no step larger than the median of the preceding 10 frames, judged also by eye from the screencast.

F-M2-3 and F-M2-4 are confirmed fixed in the production build: no uncaught promise rejection on page load or on any failure path, and every failure dialog shows a plain sentence with no chunk number or URL.

The accepted Avatar.tsx edit is behaviour-neutral: the hero loads, idles, plays gestures, follows the mouse and talk starts a session request with no new console errors, and no project GLB uses meshopt or draco compression (checked in the files).

No regression since round 1: warm and cold Play at scroll 0 show no blank, T-pose or layout-jump frame and rAF p95 under 20 ms on the real GPU, Exit is pixel-exact, and a 10 Play and Exit plus 5 Play and Cancel cycle run keeps listener and DOM counts identical.

Every finding is reported with file, line, severity, trigger, consequence, evidence and rule, and the verdict is approved only if every criterion above passed; owner-deferred camera findings F7, F8 and the Codex minDistance finding are not grounds for rejection.
